summary: Library (one commit, the builder's branch applied without two commits for later milestones), two passes with the server's catalog list read: fix-first (list rows lacked the card's actions; a profile-switch probe that could no longer fail; a pressed letter disabled under the keyboard; an A to Z jump with no bound; the sticky strip covering its target at tablet widths; touch targets under 44px; a line colour as a fill), then lows-only. Open lows: the sort select and Back to collections are under 44px on a tablet's coarse pointer; the More button sits inside a role=button row; the strip can vanish under keyboard focus when a refresh takes the total past the limit; Load More's drop after a same-profile switch is unpinned.
